observations: Architecture: The project follows a strict multi-tier desktop architecture: Java Swing/FlatLaf GUI -> BUS -> DAO -> Entity, supported by helper classes in utils (referenced in AGENTS.md, docs/ai-context/ARCHITECTURE.md, and README.md). GUI components must not call DAO or SQL directly. This structure is reflected in src/bus/DangNhapBus.java (which coordinates dao.TaiKhoanDAO, dao.NhanVienDAO, entity.NhanVien, and entity.TaiKhoan) and src/utils/UserSession.java (which manages session and RBAC access permissions).

Separation of Compile, Database, and UI Testing: As mandated in AGENTS.md ('Báo riêng kết quả compile, UI và CSDL. Không suy ra nghiệp vụ đúng từ compile thành công') and docs/ai-context/DECISIONS.md (Decision 7), compile success is strictly distinguished from runtime database and UI verification. While Java 17 compilation succeeds (AUDIT_FIX_PROGRESS.md, docs/ai-context/STATUS.md), database connectivity and runtime behavior remain an active uncertainty because the SQL Server instance was offline during setup and prior audits; no migrations or JDBC executions should be assumed or run without an explicit plan.

No-Git Policy: Operating guidelines strictly forbid any Git or GitHub operations (AGENTS.md, docs/ai-context/STATUS.md, docs/ai-context/DECISIONS.md Decision 6). No git commit, branch, worktree, push, or git configuration modifications are permitted; local file backups and local diffs are used instead. Historical references to Git in AUDIT_FIX_PROGRESS.md (such as git diff --check) are superseded by the current operative directive.
